signature.one_line: Game-show versus format: boxed 1-2-word captions at 78 % height, two-size jump cuts, pixel-art P1-vs-P2 scoreboard and a score-comment CTA after every round.
unique_devices: Boxed caption rail: 1-2 words, bold neo-grotesque 50 px white on a text-hugging rounded rgba(47,47,47,.75) box (86 px tall, 25 px side padding), fixed at 78.4 % height on talking head, screen and split shots alike; hard cut ~6-7 frames after the first word

Game frame: full-frame pixel-art P1-vs-P2 scoreboard card (~94 frames; logos wipe in, names reveal letter by letter) plus a spoken score-comment CTA after every round and an early promise that the last round decides it
First-shot-only serif question title: 2-line accent high-contrast display serif '<A> vs <B>: question?' at 12.5-21.8 % height, gone at the first cut
Two-size jump cuts (MS <-> ~130-150 % MCU/CU every 30-90 frames) with contender logo + name labels on top of every screen capture and top/bottom splits for same-prompt comparisons
signature.why_it_works: Viewers score along like a game: the question title, result-first flash and promised decider round keep a long comparison watchable, while the fixed boxed captions read on any background.

hook.type: open loop (question title) + result first (finished outputs flashed)
hook.first_frame: medium shot of the speaker in a warm lamp-lit home studio under a 2-line accent serif question title, boxed caption at 78 % height

structure.what: question title, framing of the stakes, a short flash of finished outputs, MCU/CU jump cuts
scoreboard card introduces the contenders; output montage; retention promise that the final round decides
round 1: same prompt, both outputs shown in screen captures; score-comment CTA
round 2: split-screen prompts, one fails, the other ships a reveal; score-comment CTA
round 3: different routes to the same task, side-by-side results, stat tag; score-comment CTA
decider round at peak pace: fast borrowed b-roll montage, then both outputs and the verdict
slower reflective opinion takes, final scores comment, share/follow CTA

pacing.note: curve dips to ~15 cuts/min in round 1, peaks ~39 cuts/min in the decider round, drops to 7-9 cuts/min for the closing opinion; 57 of 92 cuts mid-sentence (prefer word boundaries)

captions.how: Inter-Bold-like 50 px white, sentence case; rounded box rgba(47,47,47,.75), 86 px tall, 25 px side padding, radius ~9 px, hugs and resizes with each phrase; centred x 50 %, y 78.4 %; hard cut in ~6-7 frames after the first word, hard cut out

background_text.how: accent #F4F2B5 display serif ~86 px, soft dark shadow, block centre y 17.1 % (x 5.8-93.5 %); on from frame 0, hard-cut out with the first cut

background_text.what: contender logo + name label on every screen capture
background_text.how: small dark grey at top centre (y 8.5 %, ~1.1 % H per line) on light captures; large white block (centre y 17.1 %) on dark #1D1C1A comparison layouts
off-white regular sans 59 px centred at y 25.7 % between label and result

motion_graphics.how: full frame, ~94 frames; 4-frame zoom settle on entry, logo wipe 3 frames, score fade 4 frames, name letter-by-letter ~6 frames; P2 fills the same way; hard cut out

broll_inserts.what: screen recordings of each contender's output
broll_inserts.how: full-frame captures with motion inside (orbits, walk-throughs), up to ~360-frame holds for the best result; label at the top
5 shots at ~15 frames each with a source credit

layout.how: two captures stacked on a dark #1D1C1A layout, each with its contender label; caption stays at 78.4 %

camera.how: locked tripod; alternate MS and a ~130-150 % MCU/CU punch-in every 30-90 frames; no camera moves

transitions.how: no dissolves; motion inside captures reads as soft

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital only at a sentence start)

captions_spec.punctuation: kept as transcribed (commas, full stops, apostrophes stay attached to their word)
captions_spec.numbers: digits as in the transcript (e.g. version numbers stay numeric)

grouping.sync: phrase of 1-2 words replaced as a unit
grouping.break: new caption every 1-2 words; previous caption hard-cut out
grouping.gaps: no captions over the full-frame scoreboard card

layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: box centred at x 540 px, y 1505 px

caption.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, bold (double-storey a, flat-cut t, Helvetica/Arial-like)
caption.k_note: ascenders, no descenders -> k 0.73; formula 1.88 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 49 px; render-verified with Inter 700: 50 px (both calibration words within tolerance)
caption.calibration_note: ink measured inside the dark box (clean background) on two 2-word sentence-case phrases

box.width: hugs the text (text width + 2 x 25 px at 1920)
box.solve_note: box over #BFC7C3 reads #525554, over #090C16 reads #262627 -> alpha 0.75, colour #2F2F2F

animation.entry: hard cut: new phrase and its resized box appear complete on one frame (no fade, scale or slide)
animation.timing: consistently ~6-7 frames after the first word's transcript start
animation.exit: hard cut when the next phrase replaces it

other_text_spec.when: first shot only (~100 frames from frame 0; hard-cut out with the first picture cut)
other_text_spec.text: '<A> vs <B>: / Question here?' 2 centred lines, pale yellow #F4F2B5, bold high-contrast display serif (closest local Playfair Display 700; Google DM Serif Display / Playfair Display Bold, confidence low-medium), soft dark drop shadow (estimated); render-fit Playfair Display 700: ~86 px at 1920 (line 1 -> 84 px, line 2 -> 89 px)
other_text_spec.position: block x 5.8-93.5 % W, y 12.5-21.8 % H, centre y 17.1 %; line 1 ink 3.98 % H (k 0.73), width ~88 % W; line 2 ink 3.91 % H, width ~60 % W; line gap 1.6 % H

other_text_spec.text: pixel-art game card on a nature background: 'SCORE' ribbon, 'P1' green tab, parchment panel with contender logo + 2-line name and a big pixel '0' over 'POINTS', a 'VS' badge, 'P2' red tab and a second panel that fills later
other_text_spec.animation: card cuts in with a slight zoom settle (~4 frames); P1 logo wipes in left-to-right (~3 frames), '0' fades in over ~4 frames, the name reveals left-to-right letter by letter (~6 frames); P2 fills the same way; hard cut out; no captions while it is up

other_text_spec.text: contender logo + 2-line name in a clean geometric sans; small dark-grey on light full-screen captures (each line ink 1.09 % H, centred at x 52 %, y 8.5 %), large white on the dark #1D1C1A comparison layouts (line 1 3.05 % H, line 2 2.42 % H, block centre y 17.1 %, logo + name 45 % W)

short stat tag (e.g. '~N+ hours'), off-white #E3E3D7 regular sans on the dark layout, centred, ink 2.34 % H (k 0.73; render-fit Inter 400: 59 px at 1920), centre y 25.7 %, between the contender label and the result image
'Source - @handle' tiny white sans, ink 0.7 % H, top-left x 8.8 %, y 5.9 %

style.look_intent: warm, high-contrast, muted; lamp-lit home studio, beige walls, natural skin, gentle contrast

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, speech-gap level -8.2 dB); light and unobtrusive under dense speech
sfx: hits on ~38 % of hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.38): soft whoosh/pop when cutting to screen captures
8-bit blip on the scoreboard card reveals (suits the pixel-art frame; suggestion)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: comparing two tools, products or approaches over several rounds
the user has talking-head footage plus screen recordings of results
the goal is comments and engagement (viewers score along)
a long-form reel needs a repeatable, legible caption system across mixed shot types
avoid_when: the piece is micro or short (the round structure needs room)
a serious finance or corporate tone where game visuals feel off
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B31 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B31.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 4.5:1 on {{CARD_BG}} at 75 % opacity, {{ACCENT}} >= 3:1 on the footage behind the title)
- {{TEXT}}      caption text, large labels on dark layouts   default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    hook question title                          default #F4F2B5 (pale yellow)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  stat result tag                              default #E3E3D7 (off-white)
- {{SURFACE}}   dark comparison / split layout               default #1D1C1A
- {{CARD_BG}}   caption box (at 75 % opacity)                default #2F2F2F
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} hook title                                default Playfair Display 700 (bold high-contrast display serif)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    captions, labels, tags                    default Inter 700 (captions) / Inter 400 (tag)
- {{HANDLE}}    source credits on borrowed footage ("Source - @handle")
- {{LOGO}}      contender logos on labels and the scoreboard card

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, sentence case (capital only at a sentence start); keep commas, full stops, apostrophes; digits as transcribed.
2. 1-2 words per caption (mostly 2), one line, replaced as a unit; never more than one caption on screen.
3. Type: {{FONT_BODY}} 700 at 50 px, tracking 0, {{TEXT}}, no stroke, no shadow.
4. Box: rounded rectangle {{CARD_BG}} at 75 % opacity, 86 px tall, 25 px left/right padding, width hugging the text (resizes with each phrase), radius ~9 px.
5. Position: centred (x 540 px), box and text centre at 78.4 % of height (y ~1505 px), identical on talking-head, screen-recording and split shots.
6. Animation: hard cut in (text + resized box on one frame) ~6-7 frames after the phrase's first word starts; hard cut out on the next phrase. No fade, pop, slide, highlight or idle motion. Hide captions while a full-frame card is up.

OTHER TEXT
7. Hook title, first shot only (on from frame 0, hard-cut out with the first picture cut): 2-line question "<A> vs <B>: / Question here?" centred at the top, {{ACCENT}}, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at ~86 px (line 1 ~84, line 2 ~89), soft dark drop shadow; block x 5.8-93.5 %, y 12.5-21.8 %, centre y 17.1 %, line gap 1.6 % H.
8. Scoreboard card (~94 frames, when introducing the contenders): full-frame pixel-art game card: "SCORE" ribbon, P1/P2 tabs, parchment panels with {{LOGO}} + 2-line contender name and a big pixel "0 / POINTS", a "VS" badge. 4-frame zoom settle on entry; logo wipes in left-to-right (3 frames), score fades in (4 frames), name reveals letter by letter (~6 frames); P2 fills the same way; no captions over it.
9. Contender label on every screen capture: {{LOGO}} + 2-line name; small dark grey at top centre (y ~8.5 %, ~1.1 % H per line) on light screens; large {{TEXT}} on a {{SURFACE}} comparison layout (block centre y ~17 %).
10. Stat tag when a result needs a number: e.g. "~N+ hours", {{ACCENT_2}}, {{FONT_BODY}} 400 at 59 px, centred at y 25.7 %.
11. Source credit on borrowed footage: "Source - {{HANDLE}}", tiny white sans (~0.7 % H), top-left at x 9 %, y 6 %.
12. No end card; CTAs are spoken.

EDIT DEVICES
13. Two-size jump cuts on the talking head: alternate MS and a ~130-150 % MCU/CU every 30-90 frames (median shot ~54 frames); cut on word boundaries.
14. Hook: question title + a short flash of finished results before any explanation. Re-hook at ~8 % of runtime by promising that the final round is the decider. After every round, a spoken score-comment CTA. Peak the cut rate (~39 cuts/min) in the decider round; slow to ~8 cuts/min for the closing opinion.
15. Same-prompt comparisons as top/bottom splits on {{SURFACE}}.

GRADE
16. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, high-contrast, muted, lamp-lit home studio with natural skin and gentle contrast.

AUDIO
17. Light music bed under dense speech; soft whoosh/pop on cuts into screen captures (about a third of cuts), optional 8-bit blips on the scoreboard. Master to about -14.7 LUFS with true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the caption "KEY WORD" in its box and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.25,0.75,0.75,0.82 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45"
b) Expected ink: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py with {{FONT_BODY}} 700 at 50 px (reference ink height 1.88 % H for mixed-case words with ascenders, no descenders). Required: within ±0.5 % H; centre y 78.4 % ±0.5; box height 4.45 % H; colours equal to the tokens. Title: --box 0.05,0.12,0.95,0.22 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:60", expected ink ~3.9-4.0 % H per line at the default font.
